full_judgment:
2. The prosecution case, in short, is that accused appellant Md. Sirajuddin Sheikh and his brother co-accused Abul Mansur Sheikh on 25,5.91 filed a case before the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev.), Gazipur for mutation in their names land measuring 37.90 acres appertaining to the Government khas khatian of Mouza Pelayet, Police Station Sreepur, District Gazipur, on the basis of a decree allegedly passed in their favour in Title Suit No. 72 of 1988 passed by the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Gazipur wherein their title was declared. The application for mutation created suspicion in the mind of the Revenue Officer who enquired into the matter personally in the office of the Subordinate Judge, Gazipur and came to learn that the aforesaid Title Suit No. 72 of 1988 of the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Gazipur was dismissed on 27.11.90 on contest against the plaintiffs and their claim of a decree in that suit was totally false and fraudulent. Thereafter the Assistant Commissioner of Land at Gazipur lodged a complainant at Gazipur Police Station against the accused appellant and his brother Abul Hossain Sheikh for creating a false and fictitious certified copy of the judgment in respect of Title Suit No. 72 of 1988 of the Court of the Subordinate Judge. Gazipur and use the said false and forged certified copy in the mutation proceedings before the Revenue Officer, Gazipur. The report of the Revenue Officer containing the aforesaid allegations has been treated as the FIR in the case and marked as Ext. 14. 

 26. From the evidence discussed above, the learned Special Judge found that accused appellant Md. Sirajuddin Sheikh by restarting to forgery and fabrication of the false and fictitious attested copy of the judgment allegedly delivered on 27.11.90 by the learned Subordinate Judge, Gazipur he tried to change the result of the said suit by showing that the suit was decreed in their favour, although, in fact, the suit was dismissed on contest against them. It has also been found that the accused appellant by fabricating a. false and fictitious attested copy of the judgment of the aforesaid Title Suit No. 72 of 1988 of the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Gazipur filed an application for mutation of their names in respect of the suit property by using a false  and forged certified copy of the judgment. The I.O. of the case seized the so-called attested copy of the judgment of the aforesaid Title Suit No. 72 of 1988 froth accused appellant Md. Sirajuddin Sheikh as per seizure list Ext. 12. The forged and fabricated attested copy of the judgment of Title Suit No. 72 of 1988, seized from accused appellant Sirajuddin Sheikh, has been marked as Ext-11. In the facts of the case, it is evident that accused appellant Sirajuddin Sk. and his brother Mansur Sk., since acquitted, by creating a false and fabricated copy of the judgment of Title Suit No. 72 of 1988 used. The same in their bid to mutatate their names in a mutation proceeding before the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Gazipur for illegaly grabbing 37.90 acres of Government Khas land. It is manifestly evident that accused appellant. Sirajuddin Sheikh and his brother Abdul Mansur Sheikh are the sole beneficiaries of the fictitious and fabri-cated copy of the judgment of Title Suit No. 72 of 1988 (Ext-11) and they consciously used it for reaping the full benefits of the false decree at the expenses of the Government. It is clearly found from the evidence of P.W. 11 Mr. Md. Nuruzzaman that this forged fictitious and fabricated copy of the judgment of Title Suit No. 72 of 1988 of the court of the Subordinate Judge, Gazipur was seized from accused Sirajuddin Sheikh. 

 27. P.W. 9 I.O. Mojibur Rahman also stated in his evidence that the forged and fictitious attested copy of the judgment of Title Suit No. 72 of 1988, marked Ext-1 I was seized on production of the same by accused appellant Md. Sirajuddin. This Ext-11 has been seized vide seizure list. Ext-12. Ext-11 appears to have been seized from accused appellant Sirajuddin Sk. in presence of two witnesses P.W.6 Md. Saidul Haque and P.W. 8 Nazimuddin. It is found from the case records that the records of Mutation Case No. 6-4/91 of the office of the A.D.C. (Rev.), Gazipur were also seized in connection with this case. In this case, accused appellant Sirajuddin Sk. and his brother Abul Mansur Sk. prayed for mutation of their names in respect of a vast tract of Govt. Khas land on 'the basis of a false and factious decree Ext-11 allegedly obtained in Title Suit No. 72 of 1988 of the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Gazipur. It is the prosecution case that Mrs. Namita Haider was the Revenue Deputy Collector at Gazipur at the relevant time and she took active interests in the case in detecting the acts of fraud and forgeries resorted to by the accused persons but she has not been examined in the case by the prosecution for unknown reasons. It is strange that P.W. 4 Mrs. Rokeya and P.W. 5 Humayun Kabir have been examined in the case in a most casual and irresponsible manner by an indifferent and incompetent prosecution. It is found from seizure list Ext. 12 that the so-called attested copy of the judgment of T. S. No. 72 of 1988 was seized by the I.O. from the accused appellant and this has been marked as Ext-11. The Ext-11 was seized in presence of witnesses namely P.W. 4 Mrs. Rokeya Begum and P.W. 8 Nizamuddin but unfortunately it has not been taken from them that this valuable document proving the guilt of the accused appellant was seized in their presence from the accused appellant. A totally callous and incompetent Public Prosecutor conducting the case did not even draw their attention to this valuable document which practically provides life-blood to the prosecution case. 

 that in the absence of any evidence from seizure list witnesses namely P.W. 4 Mrs. Rokeya Begum and P.W.8 Nazimuddin that this vital documentary evidence seizure list Ext-12, by which the incriminating attested copy of the disputed judgment Ext-11 was allegedly seized by the I.O. from accused Md. Sirajuddin Sheikh, it is wholly unsafe to pass an order of conviction and sentence on a charge of forgery. The conduct of the Investigation Officer is equally deplorable. Mrs. Namita Haider, the Revenue Deputy Collector of Gazipur at the relevant time and the person who took an active part in detecting the diabolical fraud has not even been made a witness in the case. In the facts and circumstances of the case and the evidence on record, it appears that accused appellant Sirajuddin and his brother co-accused Abul Mansur Sk. created a false and factious attested copy of the judgment of Title Suit No. 72 of 1988 of the Second Court of Subordinate Judge, Gazipur showing that the suit was decreed in their favour, although it was dismissed on con-test, and used the said document in a mutation proceeding before the A.D.C. (Rev.), Gazipur for laying a false claim upon about 40 acres of Government Khas land. To strengthen their false claim, they also tampered with official records of the case in a most ruthless and daredevil manner. Be that as it may, in the facts of the case, I think, it will be unsafe to sustain the order of conviction and sentence without giving a chance to the accused to cross-examine the witnesses in whose presence Ext-11 was seized by the I.O. vide seizure list Ext-12. The seizure list by which the I.O. seized the records of Mutation Case No. 6-4/91 containing the petition of accused appellant Md. Sirajuddin Sheikh and his brother co-accused Abul Mansur Sheikh does not appear to have been brought on record legally and marked exhibit in the case. In this mutation proceeding, the accused per-sons prayed for mutation of about 40 acres of Govt. khas land in their names on the basis of the decree alleged to have been passed in their favour, in T. S. No, 72 of 1988. The learned Advocate appearing for the appellant urges upon me to make on order of remand of the case in the interest of justice.
